name: Amoeba
# The petri dish founder: a Gatherer (collect, head for the nearest resource) that DIVIDEs
# every loop (D pops an empty stack = east): copies itself beside itself as a new
# warrior. Its descendants are rivals like anyone else. The two fat cells under it are
# spare: copy errors can turn them into armor (K) without breaking the program.
---
C6S$TMD
..

name: Gatherer
# One row, so the IP just loops along it forever (the row wraps within the body).
# Collect anything touching me; find the nearest visible resource; head toward it
# (TOWARD of 0,0 is a random direction, so with nothing in sight it wanders).

name: Oozer
# A Gatherer that OOZEs instead of SHIFTing: collect, scan for a resource, head that way
# one cell at a time. Its rearmost cell keeps moving to its front, so its body (and the
# order of its program) changes as it goes. A seed for evolving amorphous warriors.
---
C6S$TA

name: Roamer
# A gatherer with a memory: the wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack.
# Found a resource (top row): head toward it, and adopt that as the wander direction.

name: Stalker
# Hunt the nearest enemy cell; when touching it, write the poison glyph @ into it.
# The wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack (like the Roamer).
# Middle row decides: SCAN for an enemy, `|` sends the IP north if found, south if not.
# Found (top row): copy dx,dy (`oo`), write @ there (`'@` pushes the code of @ and
# skips it), then step toward it and adopt that as the wander direction.
# Not found (bottom row): drop dx,dy, keep wandering; turn right when blocked.
# Both rows wrap back to their first cell, which points the IP back into the middle row.
# (Without the branch, a failed SCAN gives 0,0 = my own IP cell, and I poison myself.)
ip: 0 1
---
v   >oo'@WT\$:M
>C2S|
^   >$$:Me!+

# Hunt the nearest enemy cell; when touching it, write the poison glyph @ into it.
# The wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack (like the Roamer).
# Middle row decides: SCAN for an enemy, `|` sends the IP north if found, south if not.

# skips it), then step toward it and adopt that as the wander direction.
# Not found (bottom row): drop dx,dy, keep wandering; turn right when blocked.
# Both rows wrap back to their first cell, which points the IP back into the middle row.
# (Without the branch, a failed SCAN gives 0,0 = my own IP cell, and I poison myself.)

name: Stalker
# Hunt the nearest enemy cell; when touching it, write the poison glyph @ into it.
# The wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack (like the Roamer).
# Middle row decides: SCAN for an enemy, `|` sends the IP north if found, south if not.
# Found (top row): copy dx,dy (`oo`), write @ there (`'@` pushes the code of @ and
# skips it), then step toward it and adopt that as the wander direction.
# Not found (bottom row): drop dx,dy, keep wandering; turn right when blocked.
# Both rows wrap back to their first cell, which points the IP back into the middle row.
# (Without the branch, a failed SCAN gives 0,0 = my own IP cell, and I poison myself.)
